items.title: 《2077》全新更新官宣！今日游民最热新闻大汇总
Bethesda 通过三款新 Mod 抢先展示《辐射 4》的后续内容
items.summary: Bethesda has put its weight behind a trio of new Fallout 4 mods as part of the ongoing Fallout Day celebration

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/20/robco-3-1792510165775.png
Bethesda has put its weight behind a trio of new Fallout 4 mods as part of the ongoing Fallout Day celebrations.

The Verified Creations label sees Bethesda support modders in an official capacity as they build upon the now 11-year-old post-apocalyptic role-playing game. First up we have FEVer Dreams, from Kinggath Creations, which comes out today, October 20. It’s a free escape room-style dungeon that “inundates players with hallucinations and flashbacks, including conversations with their spouse.” What’s interesting here is FEVer Dreams features the voice of Courtenay Taylor, who played the female sole Survivor in Fallout 4, and Brian T. Delaney, who played the male Sole Survivor in Fallout 4. That’s pretty impressive for a mod!

Meanwhile, Command Override, from Hobgoblin Studios, lets players see through a robot’s eyes and pilot it remotely. It includes a new robot hacking ability, a Robco headquarters dungeon, and — in a first for Verified Creators — a live action trailer. Command Override launches for Fallout 4 on October 21.

And finally, Fathomless, from Zone Zero Creations, is described as a cosmic horror expansion set deep within the Atlantic Ocean. “Following the path of an ambitious pre-war expedition, the sole survivor descends to a mysterious deep-sea crater,” the official blurb reads. It features a new underwater worldspace and interiors, a new storyline with voiced dialogue, and over five unique enemy NPCs. This one’s out in 2027.

These new mods come out during Bethesda’s official Fallout Day celebrations. Fallout Day itself is this Friday, October 23 (October 23, 2077 is of course the day in the Fallout timeline the bombs fell, sparking The Great War that caused the irradiated wasteland fans of the franchise have been playing in over the last few decades).

Fallout’s 30th anniversary arrives next year, so expect some big announcements from Bethesda then. What’s it working on? It’s got everything from Fallout 3 and New Vegas remasters to Fallout 5, with an Obsidian-developed Fallout spinoff in there somewhere. Work continues on Fallout 76 and Fallout Shelter, and Season 3 of the Fallout TV series is also incoming. In short, Microsoft is doubling down on Fallout, with new Xbox boss Asha Sharma striving for increased profitability.

items.title: Netflix’s Push Into Gaming Continues To Fall Short
items.summary: Netflix has undertaken efforts over the years to increase its footprint in the world of video games, but it's

content.v: Netflix has undertaken efforts over the years to increase its footprint in the world of video games, but it's been a bumpy road, and new data suggests that the company is falling short of its targets.

According to a Netflix memo seen by The Wall Street Journal , only 3.5% of Netflix's subscribers play games monthly. That's 10% behind Netflix's 2026 target for "reach and engagement" for games, the memo said. In 2022, it was reported that fewer than 1% of Netflix subscribers played games on Netflix .
Getting deeper into games is part of Netflix's effort to increase engagement, and it's not the only measure that Netflix has undertaken. The company has also expanded to live sports and podcasts.

Netflix's priorities for gaming have bounced around over the years. At one point in time, Netflix was planning to create AAA games and hired big-name talent. However, Netflix later backtracked , and today the company focuses more on mobile and social games.

Recently, co-CEO Ted Sarandos was asked if Netflix will abandon gaming entirely in the future, and he doesn't think the company will , at least not soon. Sarandos said gaming is appealing to Netflix because, for example, someone who just finished a Netflix show can stay engaged with the brand through Netflix's tie-in games connected to those franchises. Beyond tie-in games for Netflix properties like Stranger Things and Love is Blind, Netflix commissions new games like Unhinged and The Conjuring: Unspoken .

These new details about Netflix's efforts in gaming come amidst a big shakeup at the company--a number of top executives were let go, or left, earlier this week ahead of Netflix's latest earnings report today, October 20. Netflix's stock price is down 23% this year and 43% over the past 12 months, and investors called on management to make changes to help the stock go back up.
Beyond the executive departures, Netflix laid off 1,000+ people recently, which worked out to about 6% of the company's total workforce; this was the largest round of layoffs in Netflix's history.

items.title: 我既没有预算，也没有兴趣购买镶有水晶的 RTX 5090，但 Galax 无论如何都会发布一款
items.summary: These stones ain't no friends of mine.

content.v: Nvidia's RTX 5090 GPU has become particularly elusive lately. In light of swirling rumours, Nvidia promises the 5090 isn't dead but constrained supply and runaway pricing has made it a tough card to track down. So, amidst all of this, what does Palit-owned hardware manufacturer Galax do? Tease a gem-studded edition of the RTX 5090.

The GeForce RTX 5090 Hall of Fame Edition was technically already teased back during Computex, though folks thought this showfloor piece was alluding to a whole new GPU generation at the time . Now, we know this special edition is actually current gen and will feature a GPU shroud encrusted with Swarovski crystals (via Techpowerup ).

No price has yet been announced ahead of this exceptionally extra card's slated October 22 release date. With how much a standard RTX 5090 costs, odds are that those planning to scoop this shiny GPU will need very deep pockets indeed.

For context, we've stopped including the RTX 5090 in the graphics card price watch , as our Dave notes the card is 'unavailable' from many reputable retailers. Our Jacob notes that the card can be found in places like Newegg's Marketplace for upwards of $9,000 .

Those stones are far from the only Extra feature about this special edition GPU. Like many of Galax's other offerings, it'll be available in a striking white. This card will also enjoy dual 12V-2×6 power connectors, much like other Hall of Fame editions. That'll offer a beefy amount of power headroom.

Anyway, I enjoy aesthetic hardware as much as the next person, but even I can see that Swarovski crystals are a level of excess the RTX 5090 didn't really need. Our Andy also argued last year that the Nvidia RTX 5090 Founders Edition is the best looking graphics card he's ever seen . Mind you, I do kind of want to see how those crystals will refract the light from my rig's RGB now. Talk about shining bright like a diamond…

items.title: “如果点击率出乎意料，数据集也无法帮助你实现目标”——Take-Two Interactive 和索尼的老板表示人工智能无法取代人类创造力
items.summary: Strauss Zelnick and Hiroki Totoki said that AI would not replace human creativity in the entertainment busines

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/20/zelnick-1792508878190.png

Strauss Zelnick and Hiroki Totoki, the heads of Take-Two Interactive and Sony Group Corporation, agreed that AI won’t replace humans in the entertainment business during a talk at the Paley International Summit in New York City on Tuesday morning. They did, however, explain that they do see the technology as a valuable tool.

“I don’t think an AI could replace humans because, particularly in the entertainment field, I think creativity is quite important. Creativity is for humans, not AI,” Totoki said. “How to use the technology profile is important. Of course, I encourage my people to use AI in a certain manner, but at [the] same time we try to keep the rights and rights holders and creators and artists.”

“One of our division heads has said to his team, ‘You’re not gonna be replaced by AI, but if you’re not careful you’ll be replaced by someone who knows how to use AI,’” Zelnick said. “I’m fond of saying AI is a collection of datasets, compute, and large language models. That’s what it is. And datasets, by definition, are backward looking. That’s all they are. And creativity, at its best, is forward looking. [...]"

“When the first Grand Theft Auto was created, we thought the phrase ‘Grand Theft Auto’ wouldn't turn into what it’s turned into today,” Zelnick continued, then launching into an anecdote of his stint as president and chief operating officer of 20th Century Fox (now called 20th Century Studios).

“One of the biggest movies I was responsible for, Home Alone — it was completely unexpected. It went into production at Warner Bros. and they put it into turnaround four days into production, which [...] never happens. [...] Everyone thought it was a disaster. And It turned out to be the highest grossing comedy of all time. So if hits are unexpected, data sets aren’t gonna get you there, no matter how fluent they are.”

AI use in the production pipeline for games, movies, and TV is a hot-button issue. Just this week, a business strategist at Xbox posted (and then deleted) the "truth that nobody wants you to know" about how "gaming is the only industry pretending not to use AI," and Steam users implored the company to ban AI slop from the next Steam Next Fest. Last week, Epic Games revealed that its new store launcher was vibe coded . But Biddy Blas? AI could never.

items.title: GTA 5 And Red Dead Redemption 2 Are Leaving PS Plus, But You Still Have Time
items.summary: While a whole bunch of new games are being added to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog this month, it looks lik

content.v: While a whole bunch of new games are being added to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog this month, it looks like Sony is making room for them by removing several titles over the next few weeks. We don’t know exactly when they will be gone, but you can expect 11 games to be removed over the next couple of weeks, including two of Rockstar's biggest open-world adventures: Red Dead Redemption 2 and Grand Theft Auto 5 .

We've known for a while that GTA 5 was on its way out , but it looks like Rockstar and Take-Two Interactive are making sure there are no distractions for the November 19 launch of GTA 6. It's worth noting that both games have been in and out of the PS Plus Game Catalog, so they'll probably be added back at some point in the future. GTA 5 rotated back into the library in November 2025, while Red Dead Redemption 2 returned to the PS Plus Extra and Premium Game Catalog in May.

Those are the biggest upcoming exits of the month, and the next noteworthy game packing its bags is The Talos Principle 2 . A head-scratcher of an adventure, it's a great option for anyone looking to test their cerebral muscles while facing several existential crises about the nature of the human condition. Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break is also a recommended last-minute game to check out, as it combines tower-defense fun with quirky animations. Do you like Terry Gilliam's Monty Python cartoons? Then you'll get a kick out of this.
Here's a closer look at everything else that's leaving soon:
PlayStation Plus Game Catalog games leaving soon
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PS-Plus-leaving-soon-November-2026.jpg?w=636

As a reminder, all PlayStation Plus subscribers can grab three freebies right now– F1 25 , Hunt: Showdown 1896 , and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 –but you'll need to grab them before November 2.

content.v: 近日，甘肃白银27岁流浪动物救助博主秦思雨感染东方伊蒙菌继发噬血细胞综合征，在ICU抢救22天后于10月18日不幸离世，她生前因救助流浪狗“小幸运”的视频打动百万网友。
秦思雨，甘肃白银人，短视频平台爱心博主，常年救助流浪猫狗，收养了2只狗1只猫，账号积累过万粉丝。去年10月在破旧楼栋救助受伤流浪狗“小幸运”，视频获百万播放；包里随时携带猫狗粮，走到哪里都会投喂。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261020_zy_red_164_18/1185.jpg
东方伊蒙菌（Emergomyces orientalis），属伊蒙菌属罕见双相真菌，全球仅百余例报道，南非相对高发，我国为罕见发病地区。主要存在于土壤、扬尘及黄鼠、沙鼠等啮齿动物活动环境中，通过吸入空气中的真菌孢子感染人体，少数经皮肤创口侵入；并非猫狗自带或直接传染的病原体。
早期症状似感冒，极易误诊漏诊；一旦发展为播散性感染，病情进展极快，诱发噬血细胞综合征后攻击全身脏器，致死率高达50%。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261020_zy_red_164_18/1389.jpg

items.title: 《现代战争 4》通过复制《使命召唤》最伟大的时代来拯救重启系列
items.summary: Modern Warfare 4's great campaign is a fun rethink of COD's finest hour, turning Modern Warfare 2's iconic mom

content.v: This is an IGN opinion piece from Matt Purslow, who has been playing campaign shooters since he was old enough to master WASD+mouse. He has completed every Call of Duty campaign at least once.
Warning: this article features some minor spoilers for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

We’re in the final months of the year, so it’s time for the annual coin flip: is the latest Call of Duty campaign one of the good ones? The FPS series struggles with a curse few others do, zig-zagging between highs and lows, its annual cadence only making this undulating quality all the more prominent. In the last three years alone we’ve had one of its best campaigns sandwiched between two of its very worst. Thankfully, that on/off nature continues in 2026, which means it's a good year for Call of Duty. Modern Warfare 4’s campaign is one of the series’ best , and much of that is down to the fact that it replicates the formula of one of the greatest shooter campaigns ever made.
You see, Modern Warfare 4 is Modern Warfare 2.

Infinity Ward was riding high in the late 2000s. It had successfully pivoted Call of Duty from its 1940s origins to contemporary battlefields with the first Modern Warfare, which presented a somewhat quieter, eerier approach to the studio’s slick combat killboxes – all green night vision, silencers, and decaying Soviet architecture. But for its 2009 sequel, Infinity Ward brought the noise. Set during a Russian invasion of America, it pulled on the iconography of World War 2 movies to create epic battle sequences. The shattered streets of France were replaced by the burning picket fences of Suburbia, USA. You battled through houses, government buildings, and burger joints as you fought back those invading your homeland. But the frontlines weren’t your only battleground – threaded alongside those missions was a tale of special operatives, led by Captain Price, trying to strike against the Russian mastermind behind it all.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/20/mw4-1792504471458.jpg

Swap out the streets of the United States for the roads of South Korea, and the Russian invaders for North Korean aggressors, and that synopsis of Modern Warfare 2 becomes the CliffsNotes for Modern Warfare 4 . And I don’t mean that disparagingly – this formula is a perfect vehicle for what Call of Duty is very good at: a mix of WW2-scale military action and smaller, espionage-style missions. And considering it’s been 17 years since Modern Warfare 2, I think we can give Infinity Ward a pass here, especially considering it desperately needed to get the Modern Warfare series back on track after two lackluster chapters.

What rescues Modern Warfare 4 from feeling like a copy/paste of Modern Warfare 2 is how it uses the same broad outline as a canvas for very different characters and scenarios. While the headlining Captain Price and his vendetta against Mads Mikkelsen’s The Archer is more or less MW2’s pursuit of Makarov, the real heart of the story is Young Mazino’s Park Hyun-Jun. Park is a junior soldier, only holding a rifle due to being conscripted as part of the South Korean Military Service Act. Unlike the special forces operators that we’ve played as across the entire reboot series thus far, Park has no interest in being a professional soldier. And yet the unexpected invasion of his homeland by the North Koreans means his backyard is transformed into a warzone, forcing him into combat.

The campaign doesn’t have space to fully explore the emotional toll this has on the inexperienced Park, but there are small moments that let this great concept shine through – animations like a nervously twitching leg, or Mazino’s softer, more downbeat delivery. And so while much of Modern Warfare 4’s scenario design pulls directly from Modern Warfare 2, be that enemy paratroopers descending into a regular city, civilian architecture punctured by bullets and bombs, or clearing housing blocks of invaders, the tone is markedly different. It’s a similar blend of horror and excitement, painted in much darker colours. In this sense, it treads much the same ground as 2019’s Modern Warfare reboot, which explored very similar topics to the 2007 original, but augmented them with a darker tone ripped from films like The Hurt Locker and Zero Dark Thirty.

Contrasting Park’s explosive life on the frontline is Price’s off-grid attempts to eliminate The Archer. The missions featuring the moustachio’d captain (and, of course, Soap MacTavish) in Modern Warfare 2 were all Bond, Bourne, and Hunt homages, from snow-covered stealth infiltrations to exhilarating boat chases. The same can be said about Price’s approach in MW4. His Parisian excursion is the highlight, elegantly switching from on-rails shooter to driving mission, to on-foot firefight, and back to on-rails shooter, all within European streets torn from Christopher McQuarrie’s filmography. Here, the difference is technical – that Parisian car chase feels substantially more immediate and dangerous than Modern Warfare 2’s snowspeeder sequence thanks to almost two decades of video game graphics and level design evolution. As a result, it’s the most authentic Mission: Impossible set piece you can have outside of the cinema. Meanwhile, Price’s new (and admittedly very imprecise) hand-to-hand combat skills give this version of the espionage story a more brutal edge, its bone-busting and skin-slicing finishers feeling particularly nasty.

There is, of course, something that Modern Warfare 2 is much more (in)famous for. The sharp shock of No Russian may now have finally diminished, but its challenging depiction of a terrorist attack on an airport remains one of Call of Duty’s most memorable missions . Modern Warfare 4 has its own take, albeit delivered in a very different shape. The crux of No Russian is its interactivity – do you follow orders and slaughter dozens of civilians, or keep your finger off the trigger? And so MW4’s variant is appropriately called “Following Orders”, the idea given new context by casting you as a North Korean soldier asked to hunt down an enemy of the totalitarian regime. As you storm houses and question terrified civilians, you’re given the opportunity to either toe the party line or defy your monstrous leaders. Do you bring up the medical contraband you found? Reveal the woman you found beneath the kitchen floor? Question an ally’s use of torture? And will you hold the rope that hangs the alleged defector?

While it paints a very broad image of North Korea’s political situation and doesn’t contribute to the overall story in quite the same way No Russian does, Following Orders is nonetheless a fascinating component of Modern Warfare 4’s repainting of Modern Warfare 2’s canvas. It’s a more modern take on a similar concept, providing a greater array of choices for how you get involved, and pushing you to consider your own morality and position within the machine thanks to a (slightly) sharper line of questioning.

Compare Following Orders to Passenger, the rebooted Modern Warfare 3 ’s more direct attempt at No Russian, and the difference is night and day. Rather than examine and rebuild the mission’s experimental combination of narrative and gameplay, Passenger is simply a terrorist attack involving a plane. And while you technically do play Passenger, it’s largely a first-person cutscene where most of your interaction is walking forward between scripted sequences. Considering the entire point of No Russian is player agency, it’s a woeful misunderstanding of why you’d include an interactive terrorist attack in a video game.

items.title: 当然，新的 Edgerunners 系列意味着新的 Cyber​​punk 2077 补丁
items.summary: Together at last?

content.v: A new series of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners will drop on Netflix today and you know what that means: the nation of Poland has again conspired to make us all very sad .

Something else it means: CDPR's devs have been preparing a new patch for Cyberpunk 2077 (the videogame). Announced today , the details of Cyberpunk's 2.5 patch will drop tomorrow, the 21st of October, before the update itself releases on the 22nd.
Is it Cyberpunk 2077's actual, true, proper, pinky-swear final patch? No, and given the fact that The Witcher 3 just got a remaster 11 years after release, I'm not sure such a thing is possible.

Anyway, not much in the way of detail there in the patch's announcement post, I suppose, meaning we all have to wait til CDPR furnishes us with the deets in tomorrow's stream? Well, for the most part, yes, but the studio did drop some information about the patch's contents in the announcement post. Specifically, that the patch would contain new stuff in the way of cyberware customisation and "a new dual-wielding playstyle."

Which is fairly eyebrow raising. Cyberware customisation I'm not especially concerned about, though it's presumably good news for people who loved tinkering with the customisation on their cars after earlier patches introduced that feature. But a new dual-wielding playstyle? That'll get me to sit upright.

If you've forgotten (or if, as god intended, you've only played the game wielding a katana and quickhacks), Cyberpunk 2077 didn't let you properly dual wield guns. Even Jackie Welles' dual pistols—the ones he dual wields—become a single-handed weapon if you pick them up. They even mention dual wielding in the description! It's like being taunted.
Anyway, it sounds like that particular long, international nightmare is about to end. Or else CDPR is trolling us, which would be funny enough that I'd be okay with it.

items.title: 当我在一场混乱的五指鱼片游戏中惊慌失措时，我不小心用黄油刀割断了手指
items.summary: Take Five Finger Fillet and times it by a hundred.

content.v: Five Finger Fillet is, like many things, undoubtedly a creation fuelled by medieval bozos with too much time on their hands and booze in their bodies. Grab a knife and stab it between your fingers? For fun? Definitely the invention of an alcohol-addled mind. It is also something I am unbelievably rubbish at, as someone with mediocre hand-eye coordination and a tendency to get the shakies.

So it should come as no surprise that, given 20 minutes to stab between my digits 500 times, it took embarrassingly little time for me to slice my ring finger clean off with a butter knife. Not in real life, mind. I'm not that stupid. I'm talking about 500 Finger Fillet, a roguelite spin which shackles your (not real) wrist to a table while a pointy (or in my case, rather blunt) instrument attached to a rickety crane hovers over you, frantically twitching around while you slam a button and hope it doesn't come down onto your precious flesh. All while a maniacal teddy bear head watches your every move.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vW2Dj78xzJyUWCekj82sVU-1920-80.jpg

The game isn't totally demented in its demands, at least. It splits up those 500 stabs into tidy rounds of 50 stabs apiece—this is where the roguelite stuff comes in—with a breather halfway through and an opportunity to buy items. There's medication to help manage your pain meter when you inevitably slice yourself open a little, tablets to recuperate lost blood, and rings that can offer stat boosts or keep your precious pinky safe from being severed entirely.

When each round is over, you'll have to pick a new weapon, and this is where 500 Finger Fillet had a pleasant amount of strategic depth to it. Surface area is a big consideration, like picking a syringe over a box cutter—the latter of which I did and proceeded to lose all my fingers in record time. There's also a severe percentage attached, along with how much pain and blood loss getting stabbed with it will cause. Each one also comes with special conditions—one gives you money every time you stab yourself, while another rewards you for consecutive misses, instead.

It's a delicate balancing act of challenge and reward, something that I am still finding as I've only successfully made it through six of 500 Finger Fillet's 10 rounds. I'm more than ready to continue tackling it, though—thanks to a little meta-progression that persists between failed attempts, which is always nice—and emerge from my half-thousand stabs with all my fingers attached and my blood still in my body.
500 Finger Fillet currently has a demo as part of Steam Next Fest, with the full game out on November 12.

items.title: 微软不会喜欢这个让 Game Pass 在 SteamOS 和 Linux 上运行的开源项目，但我认为它非常简洁
items.summary: If it doesn't exist, build it yourself.

content.v: It wasn't long ago that Linux gaming was considered fairly niche—but given that Windows 11 is unpopular with many, it seems that not a day goes by without something regarding the switch to Linux hitting my newsfeed. Not to mention the continuing updates to Valve's Arch-based SteamOS.

Now my attention has been drawn to the Xodus Nexus , an experimental open-source project that aims to allow Linux and SteamOS users to access PC Game Pass. This includes the ability to browse, install, and launch games via a very familiar interface, complete with cloud save support.

That's for supported games only, of course, but the GitHub page has a big long list of them. From Gears of War: E-Day , to Minecraft for Windows, to Halo: Campaign Evolved , there sure are some big hitters that are already supported by the open-source platform.

The readme describes the project as "An Xbox-inspired launcher built on Xodus , using our patched Nexus backend and Nexus runtime. Browse the store, install games you own or can access through a subscription, and play with one shared runtime."

The whole system seems to be in an experimental test phase at the moment, and the controller navigation looks to be a work in progress, too. However, games can be added to Steam as non-Steam-game shortcuts, and Xbox achievements have been added in the latest update, alongside many other features.

🚨 PC GAME PASS is now being made playable on Linux and SteamOS through an unofficial open-source project called Xodus Nexus. 👀 • Xodus Nexus can browse, install and launch supported Microsoft Store / Game Pass PC games on Linux• Uses a patched Xodus backend + Proton-based Nexus runtime• Xbox sign-in and cloud saves work for supported games• Forza Horizon 6, Gears of War: E-Day, Sea of Thieves, Avowed and others are listed as playable• Games can be added directly to Steam as Non-Steam shortcuts• New v0.3.8 adds Xbox achievements, playtime and last-activity tracking• Controller navigation and Steam Game Mode integration are actively improving• FACT: this is an independent unofficial project, NOT Microsoft, Valve or upstream Xodus• FACT: compatibility remains game-dependent and Steam Deck support is still experimental• SPECULATION: if development holds up, this could remove one of SteamOS/Linux gaming’s biggest remaining limitations Game Pass library has been a massive missing piece for SteamOS. Huge credit to domsvoboda and everyone testing it, but this is still early software so I wouldn’t treat Game Pass on Linux as completely solved yet. October 19, 2026

All of which makes me think that Microsoft may be a little... miffed when it reads this project's goals. Not to mention the UI similarities. I have no idea if it's possible for MS to detect if this third-party system is in use, or if the software giant will ever do anything to try and scupper it. Still, use at you own risk is probably the main messaging here.

You do at least need a valid Microsoft account, and of course, an active Game Pass subscription to use it. Or licenses for the games themselves, so no money is changing hands with the wrong parties. Regardless, I can't but help admire the moxie of the open source community. If it doesn't exist yet, someone will try and build it. Carry on.

items.title: 香草社名作《圣兽之王》"登陆"PC！流畅运行无压力
items.summary: 由Vanillaware开发、Atlus和Sega发行的战术RPG《圣兽之王》，近日出现了一个非官方原生PC移植版。

content.v: 由Vanillaware开发、Atlus和Sega发行的战术RPG《圣兽之王》，近日出现了一个非官方原生PC移植版。
开发者hachi23发布了该项目1.0.0版本的开源程序，支持Windows和Linux，可直接运行PS4版游戏，无需依赖传统模拟器，并加入了多项PC专属功能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200959081184.jpg

该移植版基于PS4版本，支持最高4K渲染分辨率，提供多种渲染与缩放选项；支持AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1（FSR 1），可通过图像缩放提升性能；提供可调强度的AMD RCAS锐化滤镜、垂直同步和帧率限制；支持键盘操作与自定义按键，兼容手柄并支持按键配置；可选择PlayStation、Xbox和Nintendo Switch按键图标，并支持自动检测已连接手柄；通过Insert键可呼出集成设置菜单，调整画面、性能和操作选项，同时显示FPS和性能统计。程序基于Vulkan 1.3进行图形处理。
项目已在GitHub发布，更新和已知问题也在该页面公布。使用者需要自备兼容的PS4版游戏文件，程序本身不包含游戏原始文件。所需版本为CUSA36381（亚洲区），并集成1.04更新；其他地区或版本未获启动器官方支持，可能在配置阶段被拒绝。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200959166116.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200959164934.jpg
根据hachi23分享的测试，使用四核AMD Ryzen 5 2500U和Radeon RX 560X的笔记本，在1080p下《圣兽之王》大致运行在50至60 FPS；序章开场曾短暂降至约47 FPS，第一个战斗场景约53 FPS。这表明游戏在不少现代电脑上可能有不错的表现，但目前还不足以确定最终推荐配置。项目在初始着色器编译时可能出现短暂卡顿，缓存后后续运行会有所改善。
开发者确认已测试序章和第一章开头，包括第一场战斗和存档操作，但尚未验证完整战役，因此不能保证所有任务、过场和系统都正常运行。运行环境需要Windows 10 1903以上、Windows 11或64位Linux，支持Vulkan 1.3的GPU及较新驱动，x86-64处理器；游戏原始文件提取后约占用7GB存储空间。

items.title: 法国暴乱游戏店主回应走红出圈：我不是英雄
items.summary: 法国暴乱期间，尼斯Micromania游戏店经理皮埃尔·科林为保护店铺遭袭击的视频在网络走红。

content.v: 法国暴乱期间，尼斯Micromania游戏店经理皮埃尔·科林为保护店铺遭袭击的视频在网络走红。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201412578437.jpg
而后，他在尼斯警察局报案后接受采访，讲述了事发经过和自己的想法。
科林说，事情纯属偶然。那张海报一直贴在那里，破坏者恰好砸碎了它所在的玻璃；如果砸的是另一块玻璃，旁边什么都没有，视频可能根本不会传播得这么广。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201413413713.png
他身体没有大碍，只有几处擦伤和扭伤，但心理上还没完全缓过来。他直言自己不是超级英雄，也谈不上勇敢，当时更多是出于“愚蠢”，因为那一刻并没完全意识到发生了什么。他的伴侣当时很害怕，一直让他离开。
最让他难受的，是看到有人对着打砸行为发笑。他原本在休假，接到消息说店里被砸、员工失联，才赶到现场。起初他站在一旁，告诉自己不值得冒险，但后来还是走到人群中间。他和妻子都被投掷物击中，一块石头从他额头前几厘米飞过。他说，自己只是希望人们意识到，那里不只是一扇橱窗，而是有人生活、有家庭顾客的地方。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201414145414.jpg
科林也提到，有善良的人过来帮助和支持他，他并非独自对抗所有人。让他难过的是，附近许多店铺同样受损，连超市的水都被抢走，这说明破坏并非出于需要。

items.title: 官方大力水手5流出！非官方游戏实测：性能暴涨90%
items.summary: 官方大力水手5流出！非官方游戏实测：性能暴涨90%

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201322563066.png
据报道，NVIDIA近日在《NBA 2K27》中推送的新版DLSS 5神经渲染模型已被模组开发者成功提取并流出。开发者迅速将其注入到非官方支持的游戏中进行测试，结果令人震惊。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201323045356.png
据X平台用户Gaming Optimized实测，在《巫师3》原生调用DLSS 5的情况下，新版模型相比旧版性能提升最高达90%。此外，在《极限竞速：地平线6》中帧率提升近40%，《生化危机：安魂曲》提升约30%。
这一性能飞跃源于NVIDIA对AI模型的深度优化。官方数据显示，新版NR模型参数量缩减24%至约1.18亿，4K分辨率下显存占用降低20%，神经渲染工作负载处理速度提升2倍。在消费级GPU显存无法升级的约束下，NVIDIA选择让模型更小、更高效。
模组社区还发现，新版DLL内置了两个预设：Preset A为旧模型，Preset B为新模型，方便玩家直接对比。同时，社区已修改运行时以支持RTX 20系列显卡，而NVIDIA官方目前仅计划将DLSS 5下放至RTX 40系列。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201323149481.png
从90%的性能提升到20%的显存节省，新版DLSS 5证明了软件优化在AI渲染时代的巨大潜力。对于非官方支持的游戏而言，模组社区的探索正在打破NVIDIA的生态边界。

items.title: PS5惨遭破解 旧固件主机价格炒疯 二手市场乱了
items.summary: PS5越狱正在以相当快的速度扩散，而且门槛并不高。这一情况正让越来越多玩家想买一台能够进行越狱的主机，二手市场价格也随之被推高。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201126243402.png
据everyeye消息，PS5越狱正在以相当快的速度扩散，而且门槛并不高。这一情况正让越来越多玩家想买一台能够进行越狱的主机，二手市场价格也随之被推高。
报道指出，不少玩家已经把自己的PS5升级到最新固件，之后才发现越狱相关消息，于是开始考虑再买一台固件较旧的第二台主机。持有符合越狱条件PS5的人则借机高价转卖。由于缺货和内存危机，PS5原本价格已经不低，如今可越狱的旧固件机型更是水涨船高。
二手市场因此变得很难下手。即便是没有其他意图、只想合法游玩已购买游戏的玩家，也面临普通PS5 Slim价格很高、PS5 Pro二手价突破1000欧元的局面。

items.title: Justice Is Keeping The GTA 6 Hype At Arm’s Length While Making Its Soundtrack
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn't just look visually impressive; it also has a killer sound thanks to French electron

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn't just look visually impressive; it also has a killer sound thanks to French electronic music duo Justice. Composing the soundtrack for any game is no easy feat, but with GTA 6 generating an unprecedented amount of hype, the team of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay are well aware of the expectations that have been placed on them.

"Yeah, we are aware of the hype of the game, of course, and the fact that people have been waiting for such a long time," Augé said in an interview with the BBC 1 radio show (via NINE1NINE ). "On the other hand, we are aware, and we see this colossus approaching, and at the same time we see it a bit from the outside. So it was a good way for us also not to let these thoughts come into our minds and not intrude on our minds."

As for the overall sound of GTA 6'S soundtrack, Justice says that it pulled from various sources to create a unique "flavor" built around several instruments. While there's a subtle '80s influence in what has been heard so far, Justice says that there's far more to the score than just retro vibes.

"We never really put words on it. 'Oh, we need to make an '80s track,' Augé said. "We knew what we needed to do, and it happened to have this kind of flavor. But at the same time, the sounds are futuristic. Like the guitar, it's not even a guitar; it's a synth, because no guitar could have this type of sound that is very phasey and a bit futuristic."

To get an idea of what GTA 6's score will sound like, listen to the game's first single, Flower in a Hurricane. Featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, the track has already earned 2.8 million plays on YouTube in less than a week, and Justice said they got to work with a dream team of performers to make it a reality.

"These are people we've always wanted to work with," de Rosnay said. "We didn't think from the beginning that they would necessarily match together, but it came very naturally, and things happened gradually, and all of a sudden we had made a record with all of them."

Beyond the original soundtrack by Justice, GTA 6 will also offer the "next evolution of in-game radio, and more" through several radio stations and podcasts . The official GTA 6 album will have 34 songs written specifically for the game, including new music from Keith Richards and Travis Scott .
For more news, check out all the records we think GTA 6 will break when it launches on November 19, and see who's voicing who in the game .

items.title: 拉了!《鬼泣》制作人新作获2分：外媒怒喷冗长乏味
items.summary: 由《鬼泣》制作人小林裕幸执导的新作《愚者不灭》媒体评价已正式解禁。外媒MonsterVine为本作打出2分（满分5分），评价相当严厉。

content.v: 由《鬼泣4》制作人小林裕幸执导的新作《愚者不灭》媒体评价已正式解禁。外媒MonsterVine为本作打出2分（满分5分），评价相当严厉。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200925477726.jpg
MonsterVine在评测中表示，评测者一开始真心想在这款游戏里找到乐趣：每次开局都希望战斗终于能进入高潮，每击败一个Boss都期待出现新机制，不必反复刷关卡直到等级够高、时间够用才能挑战下一个Boss；每次走进身体改造升级商店，都以为合适的装备会出现，让自己彻底统治冥界。但这一刻始终没有到来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200925552367.png
评测认为，《愚者不灭》虽然明显受到Roguelike类型启发，却没有真正吸收其精髓，而是把该类型的点子和机制搬过来，却不知道如何组装成有趣的体验。文章形容它像一个“彻底扫兴的弗兰肯斯坦”，乐于让玩家在冗长乏味的战役中蹒跚前行。
从这篇评测看，本作的主要问题集中在战斗缺乏推进感、Boss战后的成长期待落空、升级商店未能带来转机，以及Roguelike循环变成重复刷取而非乐趣来源。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200926077656.jpg
对于一款由知名制作人执导的新作来说，这样的媒体开局并不理想。目前本作M站评分也同样已经出炉，均分68分。

图中，塔莎分别展示了穿着银灰色夹克的完整造型，以及脱下外套后的休闲装扮，搭配宽松工装裤与粉色短发。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191724242910.png
此前《皇牌空战》系列总监河野一聪表示，开发团队原本没想到塔莎会在全球范围内获得如此高的人气。他透露，塔莎很早就开始设计，最初由另一位美术人员负责。虽然角色的故事定位早已确定，但团队此后仍反复调整她的多个设计细节，使她成为整个开发过程中打磨时间最长的角色。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191724444768.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191724469575.png
因此，开发团队内部还开玩笑称她是“最贵的角色”。
《皇牌空战8：希孚之翼》是万代南梦宫旗下飞行射击系列的最新正统作品，由ProjectAces开发。故事发生在《皇牌空战7》事件的十年后，玩家将驾驶各类战斗机执行任务，与队友并肩作战，体验空战、剧情演出等内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191726266843.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191726288657.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201412521603.jpg
塔莎·塞维尔斯卡娅是主角中队的女性飞行员之一。官方介绍显示，她在战争爆发前曾是特技飞行表演团队的明星，拥有出色的飞行技术。

items.title: 曝RTX 6060恐迟到2029年！性能甚至可能不如PS6
items.summary: RTX 6060恐迟到2029年！性能甚至可能不如PS6

content.v: 据硬件爆料人KeplerL2透露，英伟达下一代RTX 60系列显卡中的入门级型号RTX 6060，可能要到2029年才会推出，而且其性能甚至可能无法达到索尼下一代主机PS6的水平。不过，这些信息目前都属于爆料，英伟达和索尼尚未公布相关产品的正式规格与发布时间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200935089400.jpg
KeplerL2表示，受持续的供应限制影响，英伟达可能推迟RTX 60系列低端显卡的发布。他指出，当显卡供应紧张时，英伟达往往会优先保障更高端产品，导致入门级型号的上市时间被大幅延后。因此，他认为RTX 6060很有可能要等到2029年才能面世，并怀疑其性能能否与PS6相匹敌。
作为对比，目前有关PS6性能的传闻，曾将其定位与AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT或NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti等显卡进行比较。不过，这些对比主要基于尚未证实的硬件信息，不能视为主机最终性能的可靠结论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200934218450.png
如果RTX 6060真的推迟至2029年发布，意味着玩家可能需要等待相当长的时间，才能迎来新一代主流价位显卡。对于预算有限、希望升级游戏设备的玩家而言，发布时间与价格或许比单纯的性能提升更值得关注。
另一方面，主机与PC显卡的性能也不能只看型号或理论算力。PS6的实际表现还取决于定制芯片、内存配置、系统优化以及游戏开发环境，而独立显卡则需要搭配其他PC硬件运行。因此，即便两者存在性能差距，也要等到官方规格和实际游戏测试公布后才能判断。

items.title: 《影之刃零》竟还有"未来"武器！巨型女蛇Boss很难缠
items.summary: 近日，外媒Wccftech在采访《影之刃零》时，分享了对游戏武器系统的体验。

content.v: 近日，外媒Wccftech在采访《影之刃零》时，分享了对游戏武器系统的体验。
Wccftech表示，《影之刃零》的武器种类相当丰富，既有常见的中国传统兵器，也有带有机械感、甚至 未来感（futuristic） 的奇幻武器。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191707037742.png
醉剑的基础形态是一把普通的单手剑，但其特殊能力能够让剑脱手飞出，在敌人周围自主穿梭并发动斩击。玩家则可以一边操纵飞剑，一边以类似醉酒的姿态在地面翻滚或踉跄行动，形成与常规近战截然不同的战斗方式。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191707467036.png
不过，媒体也指出，这套玩法在实际体验中的输出表现并不突出。试玩时，Wccftech使用醉剑对战一只体型庞大的蛇形BOSS。由于该敌人会频繁横穿战场，并从约20米外发动攻击，媒体原本认为能够自主飞行的剑会非常实用，但实际造成的伤害却远不及此前习惯使用的巨型双手剑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191707561246.png
值得一提的是，这只蛇形BOSS或许是此前曾在《影之刃零》的宣传中亮相。它最早出现在索尼6月的StateofPlay预告中，随后又在8月12日公布的11分钟实机演示里登场。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191707169751.png
该BOSS以倒挂在树上的女性形象示人，当时的台词是“我愿意把一切，都献给大慈大悲的圣母娘娘”，相信不少玩家都有印象。

content.v: Fortnite's spooky season content is rolling out, and that includes the character Nikki from one of 2026's biggest movies, Obsession.

Inde Navarrette's character from the Curry Barker movie is coming to Fortnite on October 21. As expected, Nikki's "No, no, no!" line from the movie is coming to Fortnite as an emote, but not in the way you might expect. Instead of Nikki voicing the line, she holds out cue cards with the words on them. Check out the video below to see how the emote looks in the game.

Additionally, Nikki in Fortnite can change her face to replicate the character's iconic frown from the movie. The DLC bundle also includes a One-Wish Willow as a pickaxe and a broken wine bottle for a weapon, referencing how Nikki violently bashes a bottle on her own face in the movie.
Obsession was released in May this year and made more than $500 million worldwide against a reported budget of just $750,000, making it one of the most commercially successful movies ever released.
Navarrette, who is a fan of PS2 Shrek games , is a big gamer and has been offered roles . Those gaming roles remain a mystery, but Navarrette is going to play Rogue in the new X-Men movie.

items.title: 曝《战神》奎爷名字本不是奎托斯！被披萨名影响了
items.summary: 据IGN报道，《战神》系列初代创作者David Jaffe在视频中分享了一段鲜为人知的幕后趣事：奎托斯最初的备选名字并非Kratos，而是Domin…

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/12/08/godofwarragnarok-valhalla-blogroll-1701999185810.jpg

God of War's Kratos almost went by a different name, but developers at Santa Monica Studio made too many Domino's pizza jokes. David Jaffe, the director of the original God of War trilogy, recently put out a video explaining the deep dish issue.
Originally, Kratos was called “Dominus,” which Jaffe liked because it made him sound dominant and strong. Unfortunately, it also made him sound like a chain of pizza restaurants.

“The people on the team started making Domino’s Pizza jokes,” Jaffe said . “Every single time someone said Dominus, someone inevitably would yell out, ‘30 minutes or free,’ or, ‘Get the door, it’s Dominus.’
“After about the 50th time, the writing was on the wall. Dominus was dead and we needed a new name for our hero.”

Someone at the studio printed out a big list of Ancient Greek baby names and Jaffe went through with a yellow highlighter marking the best ones. “The names that I highlighted were not great,” he said, pointing at Julius, Parthenius, and Maksym as examples.
“Nothing felt just right. Eventually, our marketing lead, Susan Panico, was the one who came up with the name Kratos. She pitched it and we loved it, and it stuck.”
Jaffe found the list of highlighted baby names among his old design documents last year. On the sheet, hidden among the names, unhighlighted, there it was: Kratos.

“We had Sony’s biggest franchise hero in our hands the entire time and we didn’t even know it,” he said. “Which I guess goes to show you how much of success in games is just luck, timing, and, in this case, marketing.”

Jaffe has previously talked about Dominus and the creation of Kratos, but he’s never gone into this much detail about the process. He previously just said that marketing didn’t like Dominus, but the pizza stuff is certainly a new development.

God of War's first release was the 2005 PS2 game of the same name. It was a big hit, spawning a franchise that has seen significant success over the past 20 years. The next game in the series, God of War: Laufey, is due out on PS5 in February 2027. Santa Monica Studio head of creative Cory Barlog has confirmed that an untitled new God of War game with Kratos back as the protagonist is also in development .

items.summary: PS5最新固件遭黑客攻破！《GTA6》或能运行

content.v: 据Playground.ru报道，黑客Gezine近日发布了一段视频，声称成功突破索尼PS5最新的14.10系统固件，并在演示中展示了主机的开发者菜单。不过，截至目前，相关破解尚未公开发布，普通玩家还无法直接使用这一成果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610200959277832.png
此次消息受到关注，与《GTA6》传闻中的系统要求有关。此前，追踪PlayStation Store后台数据的账号PlayStation Game Size称，GTA6在PS5上可能要求系统固件达到14.10.00.00或更高版本。该信息尚未得到Rockstar Games或索尼官方确认，但如果最终属实，仍停留在旧版系统的破解主机可能无法直接运行游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201002003332.png
目前公开的PS5破解方案Relapse主要支持最高13.60版本。索尼随后推出的14.00和14.10更新修复了部分安全漏洞，使现有破解方案无法直接应用于较新的系统版本。因此，对于希望保留破解功能的玩家而言，升级系统与运行新游戏之间可能出现冲突。
Playground.ru还推测，Gezine这次可能不会急于公开破解成果，以免索尼在GTA6发售前修补相关漏洞。不过，这只是媒体的推测，黑客尚未明确公布完整发布计划，也没有证据证明此次突破已1经能够运行未经授权的游戏。

items.title: 《黑神话》打开国产3A大门!却有大批项目夭折:等不起
items.summary: 《黑神话》打开国产3A大门！却有大批项目夭折：投资人等不起

content.v: 《黑神话：悟空》的成功不仅证明了国产买断制3A单机游戏的市场潜力，也引发了中国游戏行业的新一轮投资热潮。不过，业内人士 Daniel Olimac 指出，这股热潮背后还有一个值得关注、却较少被讨论的现象：过去两三年间，一批国产3A项目被取消，或中途转向其他开发方向。
他认为，问题之一在于投资者低估了游戏开发的时间成本。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201410344307.png
《黑神话：悟空》取得成功后，不少投资人和风投机构开始将资金投入国产高品质单机游戏，但其中一些人并不了解大型游戏的开发周期。当他们发现项目需要等待三至五年才能完成，短期内难以获得回报时，便选择撤资，或要求开发团队调整项目方向。
这听起来或许令人难以理解，但类似情况并不罕见。作者将其与加密货币、元宇宙、NFT、Web3以及早期VR热潮相提并论：当某个领域突然受到追捧时，一些投资者可能在缺乏充分行业认知的情况下匆忙入场，却无法接受真正的研发周期与商业风险。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201405483797.png
与此同时，作者强调，国产3A游戏的发展并非只靠《黑神话：悟空》一款作品推动。《原神》等国产免费游戏同样发挥了重要作用。成功的国产手游和免费游戏积累的资金、经验与市场信心，为后来开发大型买断制游戏创造了条件。
此外，不少国产3A团队的成员本身就拥有手游开发背景。因此，中国游戏产业中的免费游戏、手游与买断制单机游戏并非彼此割裂，而是存在紧密联系。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201405577877.png
这场国产3A热潮的真正考验，不只是能否吸引投资，更在于投资者是否理解游戏开发的长期性。 《黑神话：悟空》证明了国产3A的潜力，但将这种潜力转化为持续产出，还需要资金、研发周期与商业预期之间形成更稳定的平衡。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610201402072113.png

others.title: 最终幻想共鸣评论

content.v: 《最终幻想：共鸣》媒体评分出炉，IGN给出8分好评，GameSpot则给出了7分评价。目前本作在Metacritic上收录了30家媒体评分，当前均分85分。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792504455_761791_jpg_r.jpg
IGN评分：8分
《最终幻想：共鸣》将《最终幻想：勇气启示录》重新打造为经典的RPG游戏，在高清2D画面、扎实的回合制战斗和动听的音乐方面树立了新的标杆，但其故事情节却很一般。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792504486_664245_jpg_r.jpg
总结
游玩《最终幻想：共鸣》的一部分意义在于探究为何旧时代的RPG游戏会如此长久地根植于我们的记忆之中。我们有时会戴着玫瑰色的眼镜去缅怀过去，但那些经典作品传递的信息也同样深刻有力，而我们最怀念的那些作品都明白，简单并不意味着肤浅。而这正是《共鸣》未能真正把握住的关键所在。
即便其对话略显薄弱，占据了故事的大部分篇幅，这段旅程依然值得体验。《共鸣》的独特之处在于它巧妙地运用了高清2D艺术风格，树立了超越怀旧的全新标杆。正是这种独特的风格，使得原本扎实的回合制战斗系统在击败残血Boss时更具成就感。也正是这种风格，将游戏世界描绘成一个充满探索乐趣的奇妙之地，尤其是在一段段精彩绝伦的配乐烘托下，战斗音乐的激昂旋律更是锦上添花。
虽然我对故事本身的某些部分感到失望，但我很高兴《最终幻想：共鸣》的出现不仅复兴了《最终幻想：勇气启示录》，也表明老派RPG游戏可以在多个方面不断提高标准。

items.title: “The Suits” Made All The Money From Call Of Duty: Black Ops 1 And 2 Ports, OG Dev Says
items.summary: Activision recently released ports of 2010's Call of Duty: Black Ops and 2012's Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 on P

content.v: Activision recently released ports of 2010's Call of Duty: Black Ops and 2012's Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 on PlayStation, and they were massive hits. According to a report, the games combined to sell more than 11 million copies on PS4 and PS5. Developer Gavin Goslin, who worked on these games at Treyarch, has reflected on the massive success of these ports and why it feels "bittersweet."

Posting on LinkedIn , Goslin said it's amazing to see these games continue to perform well in 2026. It's also a bit sad because the "suits" at Activision are raking in all the money, not the original developers, he said.

"I poured my life into those games, spending countless, brutal hours in crunch alongside an incredibly talented team to make sure they were perfect. Seeing our blood, sweat, and tears still dominating the charts in 2026 is amazing, but it's hard to watch the suits rake in giant financial windfalls from our old code while the actual creators don't see a dime of it," he said ( via VGC ). "If executives are getting massive bonuses off the longevity of these classics, that wealth needs to be shared retroactively. Legacy revenue should mean legacy rewards for the devs who survived the crunch to build them."
As Goslin mentioned here, the re-releases are not remakes or remasters--instead, they are ports with no new features or significant updates , and that's exactly what fans had been clamoring for.

People wanted the games in their original state, and that's what they got. There was significant pent-up demand, too. Before the ports, the only way to play them on PlayStation was to find an old PS3 and go from there, since they were never made available via backwards compatibility on PS4 or PS5.
Activision marketing boss Tyler Bahl told The Game Business that, "The Black Ops ports were huge successes. We thought they would do well, we didn’t think they would do that well."
Bahl went on to say pent-up demand helped make those ports so successful, and Activision is trying to take learnings from that and apply those lessons to MW4 and future Call of Duty games.
The next Call of Duty release is Modern Warfare 4 , which arrives on October 23. After that, Activision has teased that a new sub-franchise is coming .

items.title: 前《使命召唤》开发者表示“很难看到”Xbox 通过黑色行动 PlayStation 端口赚钱
items.summary: A former Call of Duty designer has argued that developers should get royalties when older games are ported to

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/20/blops2-1792504022452.jpg

A former Call of Duty designer has argued that developers should get royalties when older games are ported to new systems, saying it's "hard to watch" Xbox make money from the recently released and hugely successful Black Ops 1 and 2 ports on PlayStation.

Former Treyarch level designer Gavin Goslin took to LinkedIn to discuss the PS5 and PS4 re-releases, which he said amounted to Microsoft and Activision "printing money off of work completed over a decade ago."

The pair of games reportedly sold 11.2 million copies combined in July, earning around $435 million in one month, according to estimates from Alinea Analytics (thanks, VGC ). “The recent Black Ops 1 and Black Ops 2 digital drops on PlayStation proved a couple of things,” Goslin said. “First, today’s gaming landscape is starved for the tight, high-quality experiences we used to get. Second, these legacy titles are still massive money-makers for Activision and Microsoft.

“Despite being basic $40 digital re-releases with zero new features, both titles immediately shot into the Circana U.S. Top 10 for weekly active users. They are printing money off of work completed over a decade ago.

“As a developer who actually worked on both Black Ops and Black Ops 2, seeing these charts is bittersweet. I poured my life into those games, spending countless, brutal hours in crunch alongside an incredibly talented team to make sure they were perfect.

“Seeing our blood, sweat, and tears still dominating the charts in 2026 is amazing, but its (sic) hard to watch the suits rake in giant financial windfalls from our old code while the actual creators don’t see a dime of it.”

Goslin went on to argue that the wealth should be distributed and developers who worked on the original games should get royalty payments, like in books, movies, and music. “If executives are getting massive bonuses off the longevity of these classics, that wealth needs to be shared retroactively. Legacy revenue should mean legacy rewards for the devs who survived the crunch to build them,” Goslin said.

There is no indication that Xbox will create a royalty payment system video games, but Goslin's post is well-timed, as it comes amid a surge in AI-generated ports of classic games on browsers. Indeed, Microsoft itself has appeared to take notice, announcing the Xbox Labs project in acknowledgement of the explosion in AI ports that have emerged in recent weeks.

Given the success of Black Ops 1 and 2 on PlayStation this summer, Activision will be keen to double down on similar re-releases. Chief marketing officer Tyler Bahl recently told The Game Business that the publisher had learnt a valuable lesson.

"We are definitely leaning into the nostalgia of playing with your friends,” Bahl said. “The Black Ops ports were huge successes. We thought they would do well, we didn’t think they would do that well. But you can see that pent-up demand of being able to get back to the good old days of playing with your friends on a Friday night and having fun. MW4 does that.
"We took a lot of learnings from [those ports] and are starting to apply them to not only this game, but future games."

In the shorter term, Modern Warfare 4, which closes out the rebooted Modern Warfare saga, comes out October 23. Will Activision release ports of the classic Modern Warfare games next summer, ahead of the next mainline entry in the franchise?

items.title: 我不确定 Steam Frame 是否会碰到这个弹跳屏幕保护程序中的任何角落，但也许如果我观看足够长的时间，耳机的价格就会下降
items.summary: Jump around!

content.v: As a PlayStation VR2 player previously, I've been admiring the wireless ways of Valve's Stream Frame from afar ever since it launched back in September. I don't know about you but the $1,059 starting price still puts the VR headset a bit outside of my budget. However, Reddit user Kebakent just shared a short video of a small project they're working on that may soften that blow.

It's a Windows screensaver, but hear me out on my vision at least. The understated project features artwork of the Steam Frame headset and its two controllers bouncing around the screen (though so far I've not spotted any of these perfectly hitting the corners ).

So here's my broke girl vision: If I click on the short video in the Reddit post, make it fullscreen, and get real close to my monitor, I can pretend I already have a Steam Frame, but I'm choosing not to actively play with it. As I watch the headset twirl around the void, I can instead pretend my good poltergeist friend is having the time of their afterlife.

Okay, fine—I admit that's not going to fool any Steam Frame-less VR head. Still, it's never not neat to see the Valve hardware community bring its homebrew energy (I'm still very partial to this custom Steam Deck boot animation styled after the Scrubs intro ). If you are a so-called Steam Frame subreddit 'Sooner ', you can download this Windows screensaver yourself from GitHub here .
"Object size, movement speed, rotation speed, and brightness are configurable," Kebakent writes, "It's free and open source (MIT), with a ready-to-run .scr file included [in the repo]."
To be clear, the Redditor doesn't own the lovely hardware art bouncing around this screensaver. They explain, "Valve confirmed I have permission to use the artwork for this non-commercial project."

That's fairly par for the course with Valve. For instance last week, Valve dropped the CAD files for the Steam Frame under a Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial Share Alike license. That means you can create whatever hardware nightmares you like based on the Steam Frame, just so long as you don't then try to sell them. You're also free to tinker with the CAD files for the Steam Controller and its Puck too under the same Creative Commons License.
Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to keep looking for a screensaver that will convince me I don't need to shell out over a grand for a new VR headset.

items.title: 任天堂第一方新作GS 9分！真玩爽了 找回心动的感觉
items.summary: 《任天堂Switch运动度假胜地》是任天堂推出的运动类游戏，Switch 2独占，将于2026年10月22日发售。

content.v: 《任天堂Switch运动度假胜地》是任天堂推出的运动类游戏，Switch 2独占，将于2026年10月22日发售。
今日，《任天堂Switch运动度假胜地》评分正式出炉，GameSpot为本作打出了9分的评价，一起来看看评价内容吧。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202135572146.jpg
优点：
集结了该系列口碑最佳的运动项目，堪称系列精华合集
多种游玩模式与玩法可供体验
除非你实在提不起兴致，否则这纯粹就是一场轻松快乐的游戏体验
岛屿皇冠模式带来扎实且富有挑战性的单人内容，部分项目还支持合作游玩，算是不错的加分项
体感操控虽然偶尔依旧会出现操作飘移的情况，但已经是该系列里体感表现最好的一版
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202136106269.png
缺点：
休闲运动的竞技模式缺少AI对手，同时也不支持联机游玩，这点比较遗憾
和该系列所有作品一样，单人游玩的体验因人而异
总评： 当年《Wii Sports》首发时我就体验过，看着简单的现实动作被同步复刻到屏幕上，那份震撼至今难忘。而《任天堂Switch运动度假胜地》，让已经长大成人的我，再次找回了当初那种心动的感觉。这份快乐，在好友相伴时才能体会得淋漓尽致。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202136191310.jpg
无论你是像我这样已经36岁、褪去热情、还没有孩子的玩家，或是为人父母、祖辈，又或是小朋友，就算是很难被游戏打动的人，也很难不在这款游戏里收获乐趣。喊上家人、约上好友，甚至邀请邻居一起来，备好聚会零食，尽情享受欢乐就好。

content.v: HBO剧集《亢奋》跨性别演员亨特·莎弗在接受《ELLE》杂志采访时透露，她已于去年12月接受下体性别肯定手术。报道解释称，这类手术会改变一个人的生殖器，使其与自身的性别认同相符。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792502610_952615_jpg_r.jpg
27岁的莎弗表示，手术体验令她非常满意，也很喜欢术后的身体状态。她谈到，自己长期以来一直接纳性别表达更具延展性的一面，并曾希望尝试与此前的身体状态共处；但最终，她认为通过医疗方式完成转变是适合自己的选择。
她同时强调，每位跨性别者都不一样，自己的决定和感受不能代表所有人的经历。恢复期间，莎弗租住了一套较大的公寓，由朋友和家人前来探望。由于术后需要保持躺卧，她称自己当时每天最多只能走150步。
莎弗还回顾了加入《亢奋》以来的变化：该剧于2019年首播，她形容刚获选出演时的自己还像个孩子，在许多方面与现在不同。当时她十分内向，也没有决定要在众人面前表演；如今，那层曾经包裹自己的“外壳”已经不复存在。
外媒详细报道：
跨性别演员亨特·沙弗透露，她于去年12月接受了性别确认的下体手术，并形容手术“非常棒”，还补充道：“我非常喜欢它。”
在接受《Elle》杂志最新采访时，这位27岁的跨性别演员兼模特表示：“我去年12月刚做了下体手术，感觉很棒，我非常喜欢。“
谢弗解释说，多年来她一直试图接受一个不同的自我形象，“就像我之前说的，我一直以来都接受自己性别多元化的一面，我真的很想尝试让以前那种身体状态发挥作用，因为我觉得那真的很酷很厉害。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792502534_686464_jpg_r.jpg
但她表示，在“经历了那段旅程并找到了自我”之后，她现在对自己的性别认同感到“更加平淡”。谢弗说：“我是个女人。我是个女孩。”
这位27岁的女演员因在HBO剧集《亢奋》中饰演变性高中生朱尔斯·沃恩而一举成名，该剧的其他主演包括赞达亚、雅各布·埃洛迪和悉尼·斯威尼。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792502534_298808_jpg_r.jpg
莎弗表示，自从她首次出演《亢奋》（Euphoria，2019 年首播）以来，她发生了巨大的变化。她说自己当时“还是个孩子”，并补充道：“我在很多方面都和现在不一样。我非常内向，根本不想在人前表演。我曾经被一层外壳束缚着，但现在已经消失了。”
她之前曾与西班牙流行歌手罗莎莉亚以及她在《亢奋》中的搭档多米尼克·菲克交往过，但她表示：“我谈过的恋爱最长的一次也没有超过两年，我听说两年之后，感情就更像是伙伴关系，而不是那种激情四溢的爱情。会感觉更加神圣和有意义。”

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202126187121.jpg

短评： 虽然里面各个运动项目的质量差距悬殊，但整体来看《任天堂Switch运动度假胜地》依旧是一套轻松有趣的合集，作为它定位的派对游戏来说表现亮眼。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202126261431.png
IGN评分：7分
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202126355069.jpg
总评： 《任天堂Switch运动度假胜地》作为一款派对游戏十分出彩，非常适合带去朋友家中，或是在后院烧烤聚会时用来活跃气氛。单人内容新增了轻松的剧情关卡与有意思的自由探索模式，丰富了游戏体量，但不难看出，这两部分都很难撼动多人游玩带来的快乐高光。

items.summary: 10W+愿望单！爆款"魔兽"塔防《军团塔防》新品节重大更新！

content.v: 《军团塔防》由 6side Studio 开发，是一款融合即时战略、塔防与 Roguelite 成长的单人策略游戏。玩家将率领部落对抗帝国，既要指挥战士冲锋夺岛、攻占敌方要塞，也要建造箭塔与防御工事、抢占资源点，在攻防、经济与扩张之间寻找平衡。
《军团塔防》现已参加Steam新品节活动，提供免费试玩Demo，同步开启史上重大更新【遗忘之力】：开启全新局外成长“符文”系统；提供全新且更大的要塞地图；全新单位敌人和BOSS【巨魔骑士】等待玩家挑战……更多新内容，等待玩家的构筑体验！
喜欢《魔兽》《星际》的暴雪老玩家不妨前往 Steam 体验试玩，将游戏加入愿望单，关注后续开发动态！
APP用户【一键加入愿望单】
《 军团塔防（Dawn of Defense） 》宣传片：
《军团塔防》以部落与暗影“永恒帝国”的存亡对抗为核心剧情，庞大的永恒帝国已派出精锐军团踏平北境，妄图让当地众神归于沉寂，玩家将作为部落最后的守护者，以先祖神圣枢纽斯皮里敦为据点，扛起防御与反攻的重任，誓要重夺故土、重振部落荣光。
游戏核心玩法围绕双线战场展开，考验玩家的统筹与战术能力：一方面需构筑坚固防线，建造多样防御塔、集结部落战士，抵御敌军源源不断的浪潮式进攻；另一方面要抓住战机，指挥部落英雄与精锐战士发起RTS攻城战，逐岛攻克敌方据点，收复被侵占的土地。每位英雄都拥有独特技能与强大威力，合理召唤与运用，能轻松扭转战局走向。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/03/03/origin_202603031858244040.gif
攻防之外，经济运营是长期作战的关键。每一座被攻下的岛屿，都是族人的新立足之地，玩家需在此建造塔楼、扩充战士队伍、掠取战略资源，搭建稳定的经济体系，为防线加固和部队补给提供坚实支撑，实现攻防与发展的动态平衡。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/03/03/origin_202603031858326462.gif
游戏的轻度Roguelite成长机制的核心的是古老符文石，每一场战斗都是一次神圣试炼，即便失败也不会重置关键进度，反而能唤醒符文石中尘封的力量，解锁防御塔、战士、经济三大类升级项，让每一局的战术组合都焕然一新。同时，玩家需直面拥有独特战术的帝国军阀，在反复挑战中摸清其行动规律、揭开其真面目，调整策略夺取胜利，在不断磨砺中变强，最终率领部落驱逐永恒帝国，迎接防御的黎明。

items.title: 《最终幻想》新作获满分盛赞：系列40年集大成之作！
items.summary: 《最终幻想：共鸣》完整评测

content.v: 西班牙媒体hardzone发布《最终幻想：共鸣》完整评测，作者在PS5上体验约50小时后给出高度评价，称其为“系列近40年的集大成之作”，并认为它已成为自己最喜欢的《最终幻想》之一。游戏由Square Enix发行、Lancarse开发，10月22日登陆PC、PS5、Xbox及Switch。
优点：故事从开篇到结尾都保持吸引力，角色和悬念让人愿意一直追下去；回合制战斗与“Vision”系统结合紧密，探索、培养、配装形成良性循环；对系列历代作品的致敬自然且有诚意，HD-2D美术和光影表现漂亮，配乐水准很高；PS5版运行流畅，价格与内容量匹配。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202112139010.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202112131847.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202112147350.png
缺点：缺少集中管理Vision的菜单，技能多起来后查找和配置比较麻烦；“Libra”提供的敌人信息偏少，部分图标含义不够清晰；英文配音与西班牙语字幕之间存在不少意译偏差，个别文本还出现了其他语言。评测认为这些不足不影响整体体验，但若后续更新能优化管理界面，游戏会更接近完美。

items.title: 马斯克计划向7300万美国儿童赠送SpaceX股份 价值超百亿美元
items.summary: 埃隆·马斯克周一承诺，他将让美国的每个孩子都持有他旗下价值2万亿美元的航空航天和人工智能公司SpaceX的一份股份。马斯克在X上表示：“明年，我会把我持有的SpaceX股份分给美国的每个孩子。这将是众多捐赠中的第一个。”

content.v: 埃隆·马斯克周一承诺，他将让美国的每个孩子都持有他旗下价值2万亿美元的航空航天和人工智能公司SpaceX的一份股份。马斯克在X上表示：“明年，我会把我持有的SpaceX股份分给美国的每个孩子。这将是众多捐赠中的第一个。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792501464_900608.jpg
SpaceX今年6月才开始公开交易（而且是史上规模最大的首次公开募股）。截至上周五收盘，该公司股价约为146美元。马斯克的提议缺乏细节。目前尚不清楚这些股份将如何分配给数千万美国儿童，也不清楚他们是否都有资格获得。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792501286_635723.jpg
根据美国人口普查局的数据，美国约有7300万18岁以下的人口，按SpaceX目前的股价计算，马斯克此次潜在的捐赠价值约为107亿美元。
让年轻人参与美国股市投资并非新想法。本月，美国财政部自动为数百万18岁以下的未成年人注册了“特朗普账户”，这是一种新的联邦储蓄和投资工具，2025年初至2028年底出生的儿童有资格获得一次性1000美元的政府补贴。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792501371_131054_jpg_r.jpg
今年7月，SpaceX总裁格温·肖特韦尔和她的丈夫承诺，将向已注册账户的约200万名儿童每人捐赠一份SpaceX股票。这对夫妇表示，他们将优先向来自低收入家庭和SpaceX总部所在地德克萨斯州的儿童捐赠股票。
马斯克的提议是对Anthropico公司周日宣布的一项声明的回应。该声明称，该公司将至少拿出 5% 的股份（按这家私营公司的最新估值计算，价值 480 亿美元）设立一个“公共福利基金”，用于向社会事业捐款。
Anthropico在其网站上写道，该基金可以向非营利组织“捐赠巨款”或“直接向特定人群发放资金”，并补充说，这笔资金可以帮助减轻人工智能对人们工作的影响。
马斯克在X上反驳道：“我建议直接将股份出售给公众……我也会这么做。”
马斯克于2012年签署了“捐赠誓言”，这是世界上最富有的人承诺在生前或遗嘱中将大部分财富捐赠给慈善事业。
据其网站介绍，他的慈善机构马斯克基金会专注于在可再生能源、太空探索和儿科研究等少数领域提供资助。

items.title: IGN 8分！《最终幻想》新作战斗扎实 剧情拉了
items.summary: 《最终幻想：共鸣》评分

content.v: 《最终幻想：共鸣》（Final Fantasy Resonance）是一款回归回合制战斗的《最终幻想》系列新作，采用 Square Enix 标志性的 HD-2D 美术风格。本作将已关服手游《最终幻想：勇气启示录》第一季的故事与角色重新包装为传统 RPG：没有抽卡、没有内购，拥有世界地图、城镇、随机遇敌、飞空艇探索和全语音主线，流程约 45 小时。玩家将跟随雷因、拉斯韦尔、菲娜等角色，围绕水晶与世界的危机展开冒险。
简评：

《最终幻想：共鸣》是一款“靠瞬间取胜”的游戏。回合制战斗扎实，元素弱点、破防与“Visions”职业系统提供了足够的战术空间；HD-2D 过场和音乐极为出色，尤其是融合爵士、金属与拉丁合唱的 Boss 曲令人难忘。但剧情对话冗长平庸，反派塑造薄弱，叙事动力不足，长期靠地域社会议题撑场。它不是一部各方面都均衡的杰作，却用视听表现和战斗爽感证明了 HD-2D 与经典回合制仍有新高度。系列粉丝和回合制 RPG 爱好者值得一试。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202105542590.png
IGN评分： 8 分
总评：

战斗与结构方面，本作放弃了 ATB，采用明确的时间线回合制，核心围绕元素亲和与破防展开。每名角色可通过魔法或属性武器覆盖不同元素，并装备类似《最终幻想5》职业系统的“Visions”来调整招式与定位。这套系统灵活，但也容易在知道Boss弱点后变成“堆一种元素无脑碾压”，前期难度偏低；直到后期敌人伤害、异常状态和破防压力上升，才真正逼玩家提前规划。整体仍具备优秀回合制RPG的解谜式思考，手动提升Visions等级、配置被动与辅助法术也有一定构筑深度。破防后的连携阶段和Resonance攻击视觉冲击强，只是从HD-2D切到手游CG过场时略显割裂。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202105144897.png

剧情与角色是最大短板。故事底子仍是经典《最终幻想》式的水晶、救世与复杂反派，但大量对话像未经打磨的青少年小说：一句话能说完的内容拖成五句，反派偏脸谱化，部分角色令人烦躁。主角雷因与拉斯韦尔的羁绊、菲娜的神秘身世、尼科尔与樱的塑造相对较好，后期情感弧光有亮点；但“Sworn Six”等反派因台词单薄而缺乏分量。叙事长期笼罩在含糊之中，靠各地区环境灾难、暴政与底层剥削来维持动力，主题直到很晚才收拢，整体可预测但不至于失格。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202105231828.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202105247493.png

视听与总结方面，HD-2D 过场是真正的高光：3D镜头运动、像素特效与流畅动画结合，能传达台词之外的情绪；音乐更是本作最强项，城镇曲、战斗曲和Boss混编曲都极具记忆点。它证明 HD-2D 已不只是怀旧滤镜，而能成为新的表现语言。总体而言，《共鸣》没有完全继承经典RPG“简单却不浅薄”的叙事功力，但作为一部把《勇气启示录》重新带回玩家视野的作品，它完成了使命，也让老派回合制RPG在视觉与音乐上继续抬高天花板。

items.title: 《最终幻想：共鸣》评测：比正传更香的“最终幻想：旅人”

others.title: 《最终幻想7：重生 Resonance》评测

content.v: https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190416-5602-89823.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
在SQUARE ENIX（SE）以HD-2D这一形式探索了多个作品之后，《最终幻想：共鸣》的出现带着某种必然性，也带着一点出乎意料的完成度。它是我今年玩过的第二款大幅超出预期的游戏。
需要先厘清的一个前提是：它本质上仍然是一款HD-2D游戏，在系统骨架、探索节奏乃至视觉语言上，你都能找到与其相似的影子。但当这些元素被换上《最终幻想》的灵魂之后，所得产物足以让系列老玩家和JRPG爱好者沉浸其中。用一句话概括它的特色：演出效果炸裂，老FF味儿最正，短小精悍。在HD-2D这个品类里，我认为它仅次于巅峰水准的《八方旅人2》。
浓度极高的“最终幻想”味儿
本作最不需要担心的，就是“像不像最终幻想”。故事框架回归了最经典的水晶神话：八颗水晶构成大陆的根基，主角雷因与拉斯菲尔在魔女菲娜的引导下，踏上阻止六盟杰破坏水晶的旅途。对于熟悉JRPG的玩家来说，这套设定的走向并不难猜。如果你玩过体验版，六盟杰那句“我们被背叛了”以及水晶破碎后星球坠落的画面，已经足够暗示破坏水晶的表象之下埋藏着更深的复仇与反转，角色的身份也牵涉穿越与立场反转。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190416-7013-73172.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

从剧本来源上看，《最终幻想：共鸣》脱胎于已停运的手游《最终幻想：勇气启示录》（FFBE）第一季，但进行了彻底的主机化重构。以当下的标准衡量，它的剧本质量只能算及格；但放在近年JRPG水平普遍起伏不定的大环境里，它反而显出一种难得的扎实，无论是自我牺牲、活着的意义、童年友情，还是复仇与拯救的处理都相当传统。它抛弃了宏大叙事和大量支线填充带来的散漫日常，把重心压回一条紧凑的主线冒险上。当你不再期待一个颠覆性的FF故事，而是接受一部节奏干净、不拖泥带水的王道冒险时，体验反而相当舒适。这也是过去JRPG黄金时代能成功的原因之一。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020210835-5457-99657.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

而真正让FF味儿溢出屏幕的，是那些散落在游戏各处的系列基因：八颗水晶对应不同的魔法体系，由此形成了各个大陆不同的意识形态与国民性格；骑着陆行鸟，听着陆行鸟之歌在大地图按步数遇暗雷；蒸汽朋克气质浓重的飞空艇、火车与城镇装置；以及数量众多、一耳着迷的交响乐BGM。这些东西并不需要刻意“致敬”，本来就是传统的一部分，玩家一上手就能认出这是最终幻想。这一点说起来简单，但对比最近几部正传在风格上的摇摆，已经是一种不小的优势。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190417-6408-92494.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
HD-2D在本作中的表现，也需要放在进化而非复用的框架下理解。角色像素小人的尺寸与头身比例比《八方旅人》系列更大，随之而来的是更丰富的动作细节与表情变化。对话中主要人物配有可变的手绘感立绘，FF独有的那种介于复古与精致之间的艺术气质被保留下来。而城镇探索场景则很传统地使用了3D建模，这种搭配让人一眼联想到前几年的《星之海洋2：第二个故事R》。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190417-3993-92561.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

游戏过场演出则借助了称之为“电影级像素艺术”的手法：将3DCG影像做像素化处理，同时配合大量动态运镜与大景深特写，在像素画面的基底上制造出远超同类HD-2D作品的叙事感和史诗感。释放共鸣技时原版高清动画特写Cut In，对一路走来的老玩家而言确实有触动，但频繁释放时每次只能跳过中段，重复感会逐渐累积。像素、手绘立绘、高清CG等多种画风强行衔接在一起，难免带来视觉上的割裂。这是“经费爆炸”的代价，也是本作在美学上最诚实的矛盾。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190417-6444-48351.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
眼熟但扎实的战斗系统
《最终幻想：共鸣》的战斗框架可以粗略概括为《八方旅人》的破防逻辑与《火焰纹章 Engage》的职业/纹章戒指式养成的一次合流。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190418-2020-89722.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
我方七位队友分属防御/破坏/攻击/治疗/支援/阻碍等不同职业定位，核心循环围绕属性弱点与破防展开。削减防御槽至破防后，既能打断敌人正在蓄力的技能，也让执行击破的角色获得一次额外行动。如果能在同一回合内让场上所有敌人同时进入破防状态，则触发“全面破防”，全体队员进入追击阶段，各追加一次行动，并在结束后释放强力的共鸣技。每个队友还拥有多种极限技，进一步拉高了单回合内的决策密度。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190418-6465-38759.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
幻兵系统是这套战斗的养成骨架。每位队友可以装备一名最终幻想系列正传主角作为幻兵，幻兵可进行三次觉醒，逐步强化各自技能；幻兵有独立经验条，角色通过精通等级学会专属技能，即便更换幻兵，依然可以根据总AP点数自由组合携带已学会的技能，这一设计类似于《八方旅人》的副职业配技逻辑。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190418-2620-68677.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
这一设计使得游戏的技能数量成倍增加，而数值也给得相当慷慨，远比《八方旅人》的搭配空间宽裕的多。由于本作的法术可以暴击，配合沿用FFBE的W技能一回合双动，加上不消耗回合数便可1.5倍MP造成2倍伤害的魔法增幅，再挂上降低魔法消耗的被动，全体技能打单一目标100%增伤以及各种增伤减防，约等于一回合便能扔四个大魔法，效果非常爆炸。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190419-5115-88703.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
大地图上除了主线城镇和迷宫之外，还有光之祠堂（收集幻兵，共26种含原创）、世界Boss洞窟与召唤兽挑战，以及多难度竞技场挑战，总数量算不上多。游戏保留了传统的步数暗雷机制，大地图可骑陆行鸟加速，中期获得飞空艇后跑图效率进一步提升，探索过的地点支持快速传送。这套设计放在今天看是保守的，但它与游戏整体的老派体验是自洽的。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190419-7480-52923.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
支线任务方面，本作几乎没有通马桶式设计。任务数量不多，但大多用于补足主线人物与周围人物的关系，对性格与世界观的扩展很有用，体验不错。尤其是改造机械陆行鸟的支线既有足够的长度，也在实用性上给出了可观的回报，也有一些任务需要解谜或者有多种完成方式，属于设计上花了心思的部分。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1020/20261020190420-7928-16379.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
老派外衣下的紧凑与单薄
整体感受下来，《最终幻想：共鸣》是一款相当老派的JRPG。普通难度下20小时以内可以通关，除了刚换地图时可能出现的短暂等级压力之外，几乎不存在需要重复刷级或刷材料的时间段。支线任务和支线迷宫数量克制，没有过多的日常寒暄与友情对话，流程始终在跑主线，体验紧凑而完整。在一个JRPG动辄以内容量作为价值标尺的时代，这种不注水的设计本身，可能是一个被低估的点。
老派的外衣之下，《最终幻想：共鸣》也或多或少的显露出一些单薄与过时之处。首先，游戏的UI相对简陋，幻兵和队友经验只有数值而无进度显示，操作也颇为繁琐：尤其是战斗时一轮指令需要反复按下确认键，频率过高，按太快容易导致误触，游戏没有自动战斗，虽然提供了倍速战斗和跳过，但超长的技能演出，很容易让玩家在高速略过时感到审美疲劳。
其次，大地图探索的可玩要素偏少，设计上过于保守，多少带有一点《艾略特的千年奇谭》式的寡淡感。再次，暗雷遇敌虽然配有遇敌饰品作为缓解手段，但对已经习惯明雷或可规避遇敌的现代玩家而言，仍然构成一道体验门槛。快速传送使用起来虽然方便，却会清空极限技的蓄力槽，挑战Boss通常都要冷启动，这种便利附带惩罚的设计逻辑本身就带有旧时代的痕迹。

不过，老派并不代表全是负资产。游戏里塞满了经典JRPG玩家会会心一笑的机制，许多设计在当今已经不常见了：迷宫中需要消耗帐篷才能回复；会向玩家索要道具的稀有敌人；我方攻击技能不仅可以对敌人使用，也可以对本方使用，由此衍生出相当有趣的战术空间——群体法术反射配合对己方释放群体攻击，可以将伤害反弹出四倍效果；对亡灵系敌人直接使用复活术则能实现即死；嘲讽坦凑百闪和风属性吸收等。这些“规则漏洞”式的玩法，恰恰是老派JRPG留给玩家的探索乐趣，更不要提还有跳绳小游戏了（非强制）。
最后，本作的中文本地化有做得好的地方，也有未照顾之处。游戏中大多数对话配有语音，HP、MP等常见属性概念也做了汉化，但也有一些文字不全或语意不明，比如各种英文缩写都翻译了，却唯独没有翻译AP；队伍对话界面直接显示英文“active time chat”；对话快进翻译成了“文字速度”。希望后续更新能够修正这些细节，或者让众多翻译保持一致。
A9VG体验总结
《最终幻想：共鸣》在经典IP的加持下，同时探索了HD-2D和最终幻想两个大类的边界，把这四个字所承载的视觉记忆和战斗乐趣，以另一种方式重新包装了起来。演出层面的投入让它拥有了HD-2D品类中少见的电影感，玩法上也提供了足够的构筑深度，20小时以内的紧凑主线，除了开篇有一些无聊之外，后续则让整个体验几乎不存在疲软段。即便游戏有很明显的拼凑感，但乐趣丝毫没有减弱。
对于FF系列粉丝和寻求一部短小精悍、老味纯正的JRPG的玩家来说，这是今年值得认真对待的一部作品；而放在SE探索HD-2D未来方向的谱系中看，它也是自《八方旅人2》以来最接近那个高度的一次尝试。我已经迫不及待看到它的续作了，如果评测可以更个人化的话，我愿意给它一个更高的分数。

items.title: 任天堂 Switch 运动度假村评论
items.summary: A collection of sports games designed to spark deceptively heated rivalries.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/nintendo-switch-sports-resort-blogroll-1792452507479.jpg

Back in 2022, Nintendo attempted to revive the fun and charm of the motion-controlled Wii Sports era, but it didn’t quite live up to that lofty goal. Now in 2026, Nintendo Switch Sports Resort takes another swing at that same difficult feat with a clear focus on “more.” More sports, more outfits, more modes, and more collectibles. That doesn't always translate to a better package, with Sports Resort often feeling a wide ocean rather than a deep diving pool, but it more than makes up for it with a broad range of games ripe to bust out at the next big party. So while it may not clear the high bar set by the original Wii Sports in 2006, it still brings out the same child-like joy.

Nintendo Switch Sports Resort is a collection of 12 different sports minigames, ranging from highly competitive one-on-one Table Tennis to leisurely cruising in a prop plane around Wuhu Island where they all take place. The quality of each game varies drastically. Archery is a standout thanks to its unique use of the Joy-Con controllers, while a returning sport like Basketball is largely untouched and still feels too choreographed – it's once again missing the freedom of movement and control I want so desperately from a potential party version.
What we said about Nintendo Switch Sports (2022)

Nintendo Switch Sports, like Wii Sports and Wii Sports Resort before it, is best played as a party game, broken out for any gathering that needs a quick injection of goofy, active fun. While its sparse mixture of old and new sports varies in quality, Switch Sports largely sticks the landing on what made its predecessors memorable: intuitive motion controls, the ability to effortlessly get a group of people up and moving, and some killer menu music that’s liable to get stuck in your head all day. Just don’t expect to spend a whole lot of time with it before the novelty wears off. - Colin Stevens, April 27, 2022
Score: 7
Read the full Nintendo Switch Sports review .

The new sports can also be hit and miss. Power Cruising uses two Joy-Con held like you are gipping handlebars to simulate racing a jet ski, but those clunky controls don’t always work well, so it feels more like a gimmick rather than a fun sport. On the other hand (quite literally),Thumb Wrestling helps bring whimsy to the package. It’s extremely silly, but actually makes for some competitive matches – in my online sessions, I was pleasantly surprised with how strategy and tactics changed from match to match. Watching players develop new ways to trick and bait their opponents into getting caught in their trap was entertaining, and I found myself determined to never let anyone get the best of me.

Archery is easily the best sport offered in Sports Resort. With four different courses scattered around Wuhu Island, it feels the most well-thought out. I stretched out my arms in front of me, holding both Joy-Con perpendicular to the floor, then clicked the ZL button with my left hand and drew it back to my chest like I would draw a real bow. Using my right Joy-Con to aim at a distant target, it was satisfying every time I hit my mark. More challenging courses and hidden targets to find help flesh out Archery overall, which meant it provided hours of fun for my friends and I in a way many of the thinner options don’t.
Heated Rivalries

As you might expect, playing through Sports Resort by myself proved to be a bit lackluster, as it lacks the competitive spirit so intrinsic to the games it recreates. Island Crown, a new mode that has you climb the ranks in nine of the 12 sports, pushed me forward with a little bit of structure and challenge, but even then I found my enthusiasm waning before too long.

Its loose story has you defeat challengers in order to eventually face the island champion, who – depending on the sport – will either taunt or cheer you on after every victory. Upon defeating one of the island champions you'll unlock a few more extra objectives in the given sport. Sometimes it's an Island Legend looking for a fight, others it’s a gauntlet of challengers that need to be defeated without losing. It's a decent distraction for those looking to casually play sports while your friends and family aren't around to party, and that’s about it.

But when they are around, Sports Resort is easily the game I want to break out. So much of the joy of these games is heightened when folks in the room are cheering, yelling, and getting so into it you need to remind everyone to keep the Joy-Con wrist strap on. This has always been the spirit of the Nintendo Sports games, and Sports Resort is one of the best versions of it around when you've got the crew to play.

Recruiting my roommates to run through the sports on a Sunday afternoon was an eye-opening experience. Games like Volleyball – which I found to be incredibly boring during my time with Island Crown and casual single-player – became electric back and forth rallies that lit up the room. Exhausted cheers, disappointing sighs, and questionable calls made even some of the more mundane sports like Golf feel exhilarating.And quick, snappy menus make hopping between sports seamless as well, which kept everyone from zoning out between rounds.

Even leisure sports like Skateboarding quickly became heated competitions as we slammed our Joy-Con on the table in mouse mode, ready to race. Skateboarding is the only game in Sports Resort that takes advantage of this control scheme, effectively turning the Joy-Con into a mini Tech Deck. Intuitive controls like flicking your hand to the left or right did 360 pop shuv-its and quickly lifting the front it off the table produced an ollie. With multiple race courses, we ripped through each one attempting to best one another, constantly pushing for faster times as our rivalry grew.

My only real complaint about the local multiplayer is that games like Boxing and Power Cruising require participants to have two Joy-Con each, meaning you aren't able to play those sports at all if you only have the single pair that came with the Switch 2. So if you're planning on having folks over to box or ride Jet Skis, ask them to bring some extra controllers.
Serving Looks

When we needed to cool down, we hopped into the Sightseeing Tour mode, which allows you to zoom around Wuhu Island in search of points of interest marked with giant floating cameras. Collecting a camera marks it on your Sightseeing Log and gives you a little flavor about that part of the island. It's a neat way to get a sense of how all of the sports fit together contextually in this space, and allows you to visit other islanders while they compete on the tennis courts, archery ranges, and more.

Between Archery rounds or Thumb Wrestling matches, I would routinely hop into my Prop Plane to fly around the island in search of more Sightseeing Logs. The five-minute timer makes it an excellent bit sized adventure that rewards you for exploring a different part of the island on each outing. Going off the beaten path proved fruitful every time, with plenty of secrets to find for those willing to be curious.

items.summary: Woohoo Island. I awake, fist contorted into the shape of a Joy-Con 2, with a sharp pain in my right shoulder f

content.v: Woohoo Island.
I awake, fist contorted into the shape of a Joy-Con 2, with a sharp pain in my right shoulder from a night of strenuous Table Tennis. There must be a new Nintendo Sports game out.

Like everyone else in the world, I poured days into Wii Sports back in 2006, and spent an ungodly amount of time taking to the skies of Wuhu Island in its successor, Wii Sports Resort . Perhaps slightly less like everyone else, I also took things far too seriously in the forgotten Wii Sports Club on Wii U, and Nintendo Switch Sports stands as one of my most-played games on the titular hardware.

items.title: GTA 6 Is 148% Ahead Of This Other Popular AAA Game So Far
items.summary: GTA 6 launches in November, and everyone expects it to be a giant, record-breaking release . But just how big

content.v: GTA 6 launches in November, and everyone expects it to be a giant, record-breaking release . But just how big will the release be? Early signs are pointing to an enormous, unprecedented launch, and new data backs that up.

Sensor Tower compiled preorder data for some of the biggest games released over the past six years, including Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2022), Diablo 4 (2023), Hogwarts Legacy (2023), and Marvel's Spider-Man (2023).

The analysis firm found, as reported by GI.biz , that GTA 6 is beating all of them, and by a very healthy margin. MW2 was the biggest of the bunch in terms of digital preorders, and Sensor Tower said GTA 6 preorders are pacing 148% ahead of MW2's over a comparable period of time before release. This is for digital games only in the US, so it's not a complete picture.

Sensor Tower's GTA 6 sales tracker says the game has sold more than 6.45 million copies thus far, generating more than $630 million so far. The company previously said it expects the bulk of preorders to come in the final week before launch, and that total prepurchases could reach 25 million . That would work out to more than $2 billion in revenue, before the game even releases.

According to Sensor Tower's data, the majority of preorders for GTA 6 so far are on PS5 (74%), compared to 26% on Xbox Series X|S. This split is no surprise, given that the PS5 has sold much better than the Xbox Series X|S. For its part, Xbox says it is very happy with GTA 6 preorder numbers .
GTA 6 is a single-player game, but Rockstar is expected to eventually release the next iteration of GTA Online , and it's expected to be a huge moneymaker.
GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a PC version potentially following in early 2027 .

content.v: 《最终幻想：共鸣》是《最终幻想》系列的首款HD-2D作品，将于2026年10月22日登陆各大平台。
今日，《最终幻想：共鸣》评分正式出炉，GameSpot为本作打出了7分的评价，一起来看看评价内容吧。

items.title: 《Amnesia: The Dark Descent》的联合创始人在《Outlast》销量放缓后向 Red Barrels 解释了“Steam 的动态”
items.summary: "Basically, your sales curve becomes like a roller coaster."

content.v: Three of the most influential games from my childhood were Pokémon HeartGold, Amnesia: The Dark Descent , and Outlast . Knowing this, you could probably piece together the kind of person I have become—let's just say it explains a lot. So it brought a smile to my face when I learned that without one of these influential games, I wouldn't have had the other—no, Pokémon HeartGold has nothing to do with anything—it's actually Amnesia which helped bring Outlast to the world.

Red Barrels, the Outlast devs, already discussed how difficult it was to pitch Outlast to publishers in an interview with GameSpot . But they also mentioned how Amnesia: The Dark Descent was something of a lodestar for the team.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MsE8jojKeoSV2rcpoY4DdK-1920-80.png

Not only did the success of Amnesia reassure Red Barrels that there was in fact a market for the kind of game they were trying to make, but the fact that no one else had really tried to ride its coattails meant there was a space left wide open for them.

Some of the Red Barrels devs even sat in on a conference talk where Frictional Games co-founder Thomas Grip revealed that Amnesia: The Dark Descent sold an impressive 400,000 copies in its first year. This quickly became Outlast's goalpost.

But when sales for Outlast began to die down, Red Barrels co-founder Morin decided to reach out to Grip for some advice in how to navigate the changing tides of Steam: “He explained to us the dynamic of Steam, and when you do promotion, it spikes back up, [then] goes back down, and basically your sales curve becomes like a roller coaster.”

Everything worked out in the end thankfully. With Outlast going on to meet its initial target and earning enough money to pay the team "pretty significant bonuses". The Outlast series would eventually smash that target, selling millions of copies with its Whistleblower DLC, sequel, and multiplayer game all proving successful in their own right.

content.v: 光荣特库摩近日公布2026财年上半年（2026年4月至9月）业绩预期修正方案。公司此前预计利润将同比出现两位数下滑，但最新预测显示，营收及各项利润指标均将大幅增长。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202041373668.png
业绩上修主要来自2025年4月至2026年3月期间发售的多款作品销售表现强劲，包括《忍者龙剑传4》《仁王3》《宝可梦 Pokopia》和《零～红蝶～重制版》，同时旧作市场需求也保持稳定。根据新预测，营业利润将比此前预期高出64.2%，同比增长44.3%；包含投资、资产管理等非核心业务收益的经常利润，将比原预期高出108.3%，同比增长40.4%。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202041384160.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202041384430.png
光荣特库摩长期以投资能力著称，过去几个季度的投资收益甚至超过核心游戏业务的表现。此次业绩上修，既反映了新作销售的拉动，也延续了公司在投资端的贡献。

content.v: 《动物园之星2》发售约一周后，Steam用户评价已呈现明显分化。当时收录的2540篇评测中，约60%为好评、40%为差评，综合评价为“褒贬不一”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792499003_900276_jpg_r.jpg
本作的Metacritic得分为85分，比《动物园之星》高4分。不过，Steam评价的变化并不乐观：上市最初几天，正面与负面评价比例约为三比一，随后六天逐渐接近一比一，近期负面反馈有所增加。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792499236_513086_jpg_r.jpg
部分玩家对便利性设计的改动提出批评，但负面评测更多集中在程序错误。有玩家表示，大量问题令当前游玩过程令人沮丧。玩家列出的现象包括动物瞬移、鱼类无明显原因被装箱、抗议者投诉空置栖息地，以及猴子跳跃表现异常。
相关抱怨也出现在《动物园之星》社区，社区已为续作批评和错误报告设置专门标签。一段角色在水域设施内剧烈旋转的视频被发布者形容为“完全无法游玩”，但这只是部分玩家的主观评价，并不代表游戏对所有用户都无法运行。目前尚无具体修复时间表。

items.title: 曝苹果折叠屏折痕明显还闭不严！品控堪忧？
items.summary: 近日有博主在体验iPhone Duo展示机时发现，内屏转轴区域的屏幕偏软，手指在折痕区来回滑动会出现明显水波纹。部分展示机还存在闭合…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202007559495.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202010567776.png
近日有博主在体验iPhone Duo展示机时发现，内屏转轴区域的屏幕偏软，手指在折痕区来回滑动会出现明显水波纹。部分展示机还存在闭合不严的问题，无法完全贴紧。相关视频和描述在社交平台引发讨论，不少用户担心这是否属于品控缺陷。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/20/small_202610202008419585.png
对此，有专业人士和苹果方面给出解释：该区域是铰链位置为反复弯折预留的柔性缓冲设计，目的是增加缓冲并释放极端温度下的收缩应力，并非单一品控问题。苹果高管此前也明确表示，受物理极限限制，折痕无法彻底消除，只能通过工艺尽可能减轻应力和折痕。实际观感上，内屏采用定制纳米纹理哑光涂层，亮屏及深色背景下折痕几乎不可见，仅在息屏或特定侧光角度下才会显现。
目前相关反馈大多来自反复开合、损耗较大的展示机。量产零售版在屏幕刚性和闭合精度上是否有所优化，仍需等到10月23日正式发售后实测验证。

从这段画面和近期多家媒体的前瞻来看，重制版在视觉上的升级确实集中在“光”与“物”的质感上。游戏引入了体积光照（Volumetric Lighting），光线会在充满尘埃、雾气或湿气的空气中形成可见的路径，让科奇里森林、海拉鲁平原和森林神殿等场景的密度感和氛围都远超原版。日升月落的过渡也变得更加自然，不再需要像N64版那样靠返回平原才能推进时间。
具体到林克身上的装备，变化同样明显。成年林克的海利亚盾和大师剑都呈现出清晰的金属反光质感，不再是简单的贴图效果。孩童林克的德库盾则被处理得更像一块真实的树皮，木纹和边缘的粗糙感都有细致刻画。甚至有前瞻提到，林克绿色束腰外衣上的缝线细节也被保留了下来，角色的服装不再是整体一块的色块。

content.v: 英伟达与梅赛德斯-奔驰宣布，双方将深化战略合作，共同推动下一代辅助驾驶系统的开发。其中融合了梅赛德斯-奔驰的汽车工程技术、安全领域的深厚积累及 MB.OS 操作系统，还有英伟达的加速计算和AI技术。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261020/1792497275_321487_jpg_r.jpg
梅赛德斯-奔驰表示，深化合作是一个重要的里程碑，也体现了双方多年来建立的相互信任，希望共同推动更多开拓性技术并应用于道路，为客户提供卓越的辅助驾驶体验。英伟达称，加速计算正在赋予车辆理解周围环境、对复杂驾驶场景进行推理的智能，梅赛德斯-奔驰具备这一变革所需的卓越工程实力，以及对安全的坚定承诺。

梅赛德斯-奔驰的MB.OS操作系统支持新增驾驶功能和空中下载（OTA）更新，并与NVIDIA Hyperion计算和传感器架构协同运行。NVIDIA Alpamayo Stack提供具有AI推理能力的全栈驾驶软件，支持城市点到点辅助驾驶、主动安全及自动泊车。NVIDIA Halos则进一步强化梅赛德斯-奔驰的安全体系，其中的并行安全技术栈能提供冗余和安全保障。这些技术将共同支持高级辅助驾驶功能，以及包括自动驾驶豪华轿车在内的未来SAE-L4级自动驾驶应用的开发。
除辅助驾驶外，梅赛德斯-奔驰还在汽车工程仿真及数字化生产生态系统MO360中采用英伟达提供的技术，应用范围涵盖虚拟规划和AI应用等。未来英伟达与梅赛德斯-奔驰还将继续努力，进一步提升梅赛德斯-奔驰全球生产网络的效率、灵活性与质量。
